title_en: In Ali Dem, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, with spacious veranda and regular layout!!
description_en: In Ali Dem, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, with spacious veranda and regular layout!!! The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of an 8-story building with an elevator and has a total area of ​​124 m2, of which 103.7 are net area. The property also has a spacious veranda with an area of ​​98 m2. It is organized by the living room together with the kitchen corner, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 2 balconies. The orientation of the property is from the South and allows natural lighting for most of the day. Has regular mortgage documentation. The area where the property is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and quiet life.
